reviewer_independence.review_basis: Direct complete source read plus mathematical reasoning and mechanical byte/hash/diff comparisons only

authority_pins.bibliography: Reviewed final corrected local theory; this code review did not independently re-query external literature

checks.subject: Represented input and domain guards
checks.reason: int/Fraction/finite float are converted directly to Fraction; bool/non-number/nonfinite are rejected before use. M and all three ratios are strictly positive; N,U,L,k are nonnegative, U<=N*L exact, bits integer excluding bool in1..4096. Ratios are tuple/list length3 and each error names its input.

checks.subject: Exact sqrt enclosure
checks.reason: With Q=p/q and s=2^b, n=isqrt((p*s*s)//q) ensures n^2*q<=p*s^2<(n+1)^2*q. Equality check n*n*q==p*s*s collapses exactly representable grid roots; otherwise the upper endpoint is (n+1)/s. All arithmetic stays integer/Fraction, with no float sqrt or clipping.

checks.subject: Rationalized kinetic map and outward direction
checks.reason: For x=r^2*k*(k+2M)>=0, x/(sqrt_upper+M) is the lower endpoint and x/(sqrt_lower+M) the upper. Both denominators are positive. x0 returns exact0; r1 returns exact k. For k>0, all numerator/denominator values remain positive rationals, so tiny-k positivity is not lost to subtraction or output underflow.

checks.subject: Anisotropic axis and volume factors
checks.reason: D is exactly the product of all three ratios; Nt=D*N. Support uses rmax. Lower sharp-energy endpoint uses rmin and upper uses rmax. No implicit isotropy, density normalization, unit conversion or source-history inference is inserted.

checks.subject: Convex/concave branch formulas
checks.reason: rmin<=1 uses D*N*F(U/N) for lower and rmin>1 uses D*(U/L)*F(L). rmax<=1 uses D*(U/L)*F(L) for upper and rmax>1 uses D*N*F(U/N). At r1 both mathematical choices equal D*U and the kinetic map preserves exactness. Mixed axes are handled without requiring all expansion or all contraction.

checks.subject: Zero branches and energy cap
checks.reason: Domain validation precedes degeneracies. n0/u0/L0 bypass U/N and U/L and set all energy/pressure endpoint fields to exact zero while still mapping the supplied support bound. Nonzero energy uses lower[0] and min(upper[1],Nt*support[1]); both candidates in the min are valid upper bounds. Mathematical endpoint enclosures remain separate fields.

checks.subject: Pressure-trace outward composition
checks.reason: The lower expression uses Ulower with Lupper; its support coefficient decreases with L. The upper uses Uupper and exact Nt; for a=M*Nt>0 its U derivative is (1+a^2/(U+a)^2)/3>0. Positive-domain denominators and the zero branch are correct. Documentation claims Tr(P)/3 only, not isotropic tensor stress or sharp composed pressure bounds.

checks.subject: Independent future fixture oracles
checks.reason: For a>0 the fixture independently brackets a*sqrt(q)+b via transformed rational endpoint squares. It requires nonnegative right endpoint and permits a negative lower endpoint correctly. It does not import/use production isqrt helper. Identity, expansion, contraction and mixed radical constants match the frozen contract; tiny k uses the independent identity (F+M)^2 relative to Q.

checks.subject: Fixture boundary and homogeneity coverage
checks.reason: Frozen zero cases, invalid U>NL, nonpositive M/r, wrong ratios length, bools and bits are prepared. Positive measure scaling7/3 checks Nt, both mathematical endpoint enclosures, actual energy interval and pressure exactly while support stays fixed. Future Fraction outputs serialize numerator/denominator strings. This is one finite fixture group, not a claim of exhaustive valid-input testing.

checks.subject: Single-child prospective runner
checks.reason: Parent imports no candidate/fixture. It checks source and fixture hashes, creates exclusive raw/attempt.json before attempting one Popen, sets child RLIMIT_CPU soft=hard1, starts elapsed timer before launch, subtracts launch elapsed from the5s communicate timeout, kills on timeout, and has no retry loop. stdout/stderr, CPU deltas, launch-inclusive elapsed, exit/timeout/error and actual identities are recorded. The fixture/production path spawns no further children.

checks.subject: Scope, historical gate and permission separation
checks.reason: bits is explicitly an input-unit sqrt grid resolution, not physical tolerance or replacement of the historical2e-12 gate. The reviewed diff adds only this unit's8 files; no old gate or pressure implementation is edited. Stock remains PROPOSED_NOT_RELEASED and separate from the already-consumed current pressure release. No source-history/EOS/stopping/Einstein/L4 or total-completion claim is made.

checks.subject: File identity and exact authority binding
checks.reason: Direct current byte/hash reads agree with all8 report entries, binding and proposal pins; final corrected theory and contract copies are byte equal to root authorities. All8 /dev/null diff payloads reconstruct exactly the read files and remain inside allowed prefix.

reviewer_actions.mechanical_actions: Read source/JSON/diff text, enumerate8 files, calculate SHA256 and compare literal bytes only

limits: Static correctness recommendation only: the candidate, fixture and runner have not been imported, compiled or executed by this reviewer.
No actual assertion count, runtime, CPU, wall, timeout behavior or resource admission is established. Future actual receipt is required if root separately releases the frozen fixture.

Sharp energy bounds are conditional on supplied N,U,L,M and external positive axis ratios over unrestricted angular measures. Composed pressure trace bounds are conservative; anisotropic work and physical stock history are not closed.
No new physical scientific admission, no new strong no-go, and no transfer of the current pressure/L1 release or historical budget.
